steps.name: tools
steps.run: command -v apt-ftparchive >/dev/null && command -v gpg >/dev/null || { apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends apt-utils gnupg >/dev/null; }

steps.name: packages
steps.run: unset APT_SIGNING_KEY APT_SIGNING_PASSPHRASE; sh deploy/build-debs.sh out/debs --without-cassandra
